title: Nourishing Dense Uruguayan Morcilla Stew
description: A hearty and adventurous Uruguayan dish featuring morcilla, this stew is peppery and dense, perfect for a cold evening. It is also FODMAP-friendly and made in a hot pot vessel.
instructions: Heat the hot pot vessel over medium heat and add the chopped onion, cooking until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chopped carrot and potato, cooking for 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the morcilla, beef broth, smoked paprika, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook for an additional 5 minutes, until it is tender.
Season the stew with salt to taste, then serve hot.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice, if desired.
